question: Can the already-audited parameterized mechanism carrier (git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796, sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72) be installed byte-identically at the shipping kernel path src/spider/kernel.py, with a binding pre-freeze positive/negative certificate as specified by the director mandate -- (a) positive: distill_parameterized over >=3 induction observations -> resolve EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound non-null action at confidence 0.9 -> deterministic fixture execute status 200 -> verify true on an UNSEEN held-out identifier; (b) negative: refuse out-of-support / missing-parameter / wrong-intent bindings with a recorded reason and a null bound action, returning exactly ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN for the no-applicable-mechanism case; (c) honest inherited-path counters (retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts); (d) installed identity equal to the frozen carrier blob/sha256 -- such that promotion is enabled ONLY on independent audit PASS, discharging blocker B1? The alternative being avoided is once more running the four-arm economics benchmark on a kernel that still emits literals at confidence 0.5 below the 0.8 default execution threshold (no distill_parameterized).
hypothesis: Installing the audited carrier bytes byte-identically at src/spider/kernel.py -- while keeping the shipped literal distill() path and its 0.5 confidence unchanged -- makes the shipped package able to (a) induce one parameterized mechanism per (family, resource_type) from repeated successful observations on the frozen credential-free localhost HTTP substrate (F1 documents/records, F2 widgets/gadgets; 5 update_resource observations per (family, resource_type), satisfying the mandate's >=3; confidence 0.9; slots session_token/property/value/<derived id slot>; id-slot support grammar ^<type>\-0[0-9]{2}$), resolve every held-out novelty-0.0 in-support identifier (doc/rec/wid/gad -013,-026,-039,-052,-065) to EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound action whose URL contains the held-out identifier, execute it over real HTTP (200, body.success true) and verify() it true, with NO cold fallback; (b) refuse all three known-negative constructions (out-of-support identifier -> EXPLORE 'parameter <id-slot> outside inferred support'; missing required parameter -> EXPLORE 'missing required parameter <slot>'; wrong intent -> exactly UNKNOWN 'no applicable validated mechanism') with bound_action null on all 30 cases; (c) while the IDENTICAL induced mechanism and IDENTICAL input on the unmodified pre-install shipped bytes over-accept (resolve EXECUTABLE and produce a bound action URL for the out-of-support doc-999 and the path-traversal ../../etc values the carrier refuses, and accept doc-013 like the carrier) and the pre-install bytes cannot induce at all (no distill_parameterized/_support_accepts/TrajectoryCounters; SpiderKernel.__init__ has no counters parameter; AttributeError on a distill_parameterized call) -- so the installed carrier's support guard, and only the installed carrier, is the discriminating active ingredient; (d) reproduce the already-AUDIT-PASS frozen synthetic arm-differentiation certificate (6/6 positive round trips, 24/24 declared negatives refused, treatment contrast with degenerate-variant detection, accounting fidelity, identity binding, literal floor 0 held-out executables) under the durable-install condition; and (e) pass the sanctioned promotion validation suite (compileall, unittest including the new tests/test_ship_kernel.py regression test, scripts/validate_repo.py) such that the promotion delta extractable by product-promote.yml from 'git diff --binary --full-index <pre_execute_sha> <verdict commit> -- src tests sdk pyproject.toml' is exactly {src/spider/kernel.py replaced by carrier bytes, tests/test_ship_kernel.py added}. Promotion is enabled ONLY on independent audit PASS.
falsifier: After a correct byte-identical installation (C0 passes), failure of any gating core C1-C5 falsifies the hypothesis: C1 real positive success < 10/10 (any non-EXECUTABLE resolve, any null or misbound action, any HTTP status != 200, any verify() false, or any repair_attempts > 0 on the full frozen novelty-0.0 held-out set); C2 real refusal < 30/30, any refusal with a wrong category or a non-null bound_action, or the wrong-intent construction not returning exactly UNKNOWN; C3 pre-install discrimination absent (pre-install bytes can induce, or the pre-install kernel refuses the out-of-support id / path-traversal value that the carrier refuses -- i.e. no separating behavioral pair exists, or the pre-install kernel does not over-accept what the carrier refuses); C4 synthetic certificate not PASS (any of the six frozen checks false, or any non-vacuity condition (i)-(v) failing); C5 promotion suite (compileall / unittest / validate_repo) failing or the regression test not covering the enumerated assertions. Failure of an integrity check C6-C10 is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a falsification: C6 promotion-delta integrity, C7 literal-floor preservation, C8 accounting fidelity, C9 real-HTTP validity, C10 no-benchmark scope. A missing frozen prerequisite or an impossible in-scope installation is BLOCKED, not a scientific result.

decision_rule.precedence: Total and ordered: (1) if a frozen prerequisite artifact is missing or the carrier cannot be installed at src/spider/kernel.py => BLOCKED; (2) else if C0 fails => MEASUREMENT_INVALID; (3) else if any gating core C1-C5 fails => FALSIFIES; (4) else if any integrity check C6-C10 fails => MEASUREMENT_INVALID; (5) else => SUPPORTS. The region {a core fails AND an integrity check fails} maps to FALSIFIES by step 3, so no evaluated state is undefined.

outcome_mapping.SUPPORTS: C0 passes and all of C1-C10 pass.
outcome_mapping.FALSIFIES: C0 passes AND at least one gating core C1-C5 fails (regardless of C6-C10).
outcome_mapping.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: C0 fails, OR (C0 and C1-C5 all pass AND at least one of C6-C10 fails).
outcome_mapping.BLOCKED: a frozen prerequisite is missing or the in-scope installation of src/spider/kernel.py is impossible.

product_consequence_positive: On SUPPORTS, readiness condition B1 is cleared: the audited parameterized-inheritance carrier is established on the shipped path with a known-positive executable round trip on a real task (10/10), a companion known-negative refusal certificate (30/30 across three classes with category-correct reasons + 24/24 synthetic declared negatives), a behavioral treatment-vs-pre-install discrimination (the same mechanism+input is refused by the carrier and accepted by the pre-install bytes), the already-audited synthetic certificate reproduced under the durable-install condition, identity binding, honest inherited-path accounting and a passing promotion suite. The frozen src/tests promotion delta is exactly {src/spider/kernel.py (byte-identical carrier) + tests/test_ship_kernel.py}, which product-promote.yml extracts from 'git diff --binary --full-index <pre_execute_sha> <verdict_commit> -- src tests sdk pyproject.toml' and applies to main only after an independent AUDIT PASS and a DIRECTOR verdict promote_to_product=true. The Product lane may then authorize promotion and proceed to the serial readiness chain (B1 -> B2 -> B3) toward the four-arm economics benchmark the mandate refuses to fund before B1; C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL until the DIRECTOR adjudicates the claim, and this packet is a readiness/promotion certificate, not a claim-generalization test.
product_consequence_negative: On FALSIFIES the shipped path does not carry the mandate's mechanism: the failing check (C1 support too narrow / C2 refusal leakage / C3 no separation / C4 certificate / C5 suite) names the next bounded repair, no promotion is authorized (promote_to_product=false), and C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL with no advance. On MEASUREMENT_INVALID the instrument (identity, literal floor, accounting, promotion delta, real-HTTP validity or benchmark scope), not the mechanism, is at fault and the run must not be read as scientific evidence. On BLOCKED the smallest next action is to restore the missing frozen artifact or grant the required scope.

No GPU, no LLM calls, no credentials.
